title: Merritt Low Dresser
notes: Shopify ?variant=<id> URL (no ?color=). The variant id resolves to "Slate" only via the Dawn-style variants array in <script type="application/json">; og:image and gallery order reflect the default Oak (walnut) variant. Colorways differ only by a filename token (merrittlowdresser{walnut,black,white}{1,2}), so the requested variant's featured_image plus token attribution picks the black shots and filters walnut/white. The Slate hero also appears in the sticky add-to-cart bar (suspect container). No product JSON-LD in the server render (injected by client JS); price lives only in script JSON.
